I replied to Pree in our DM: the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork is due **15 May**.

- **Where the date comes from:** Pree gave it to me in an earlier DM, for the Marrow Agrisupply / Greywater renewal. My memory has it, but that earlier DM wasn't in the current DM history.
- **No year was recorded:** 15 May 2026 has already passed (today is 21 Oct 2026), so I said it probably means 15 May 2027. I asked Pree to correct me if that's wrong.
- **Nothing else to confirm it:** there's no Marrow account folder in the shared files, and the Central channels only cover the June rollout problems. I suggested Pree check the year against the contract or with the customer.

My notes also list Marrow cutoffs for Tobias (9 August, Moorland) and Hollis (20 September, Thistle). Both came from their own private DMs, so I didn't share them with Pree.
